title: onprem/airgap: vendor rke2 + ubuntu packages into offline bundle, fix kube-distro detection
author: Priya Nair <priya@redwood.ai>
description:
This PR prepares the on-prem airgap offline installer for a broader set of customer environments: it vendors the RKE2 runtime and Ubuntu packaging artifacts into the offline bundle, fixes kube-distro detection logic (RKE2 vs k3s vs upstream kubeadm), and updates the bundle generation pipeline to produce a single multi-distro artifact. Motivation: recent installs on RKE2+Ubuntu were failing during preflight due to missing vendor packages and brittle distro detection. This change reduces customer friction for Private deployments and enables automated upgrades in airgapped environments.

What changed (high level):
- Vendor: packaged rke2 binaries (v1.26.6+rke2r1) and related systemd units into the offline bundle for Ubuntu x86_64.
- Vendor: added vendor manifests for cloud-init, containerd and upstream IPtables packages so preflight can run without external network.
- Installer: updated kube-distro detection to look for /etc/rancher/rke2/config.yaml and rke2 systemd units; fallback order is now: rke2 -> k3s -> kubeadm.
- Bundle tooling: bundle generator now includes a distro index file and retains package signatures (TUF metadata updated).
- Upgrade path: added offline bundle hooks that ensure rke2 service is stopped before component replacement and can rollback to previous rke2 binary on failure.
- Tests: added new CI job (airgap-bundle-validate) which unpacks the bundle into a VM image and runs preflight/installation smoke tests for RKE2+Ubuntu.

Why this is safe: vendoring only adds prebuilt binaries and package manifests; runtime behavior is unchanged. Installer detects distro explicitly and runs the appropriate orchestration steps. The change includes unit tests for detection logic and integration smoke tests for the offline bundle.

Checklist: 
- [x] Vendor rke2 binaries and systemd units into bundle
- [x] Add distro detection unit tests
- [x] Add airgap-bundle-validate CI job
- [x] Update bundle generator to emit distro-index.json and TUF metadata
- [x] Document upgrade/rollback notes in onprem README

Testing performed: 
- Local bundle generation and install on Ubuntu 22.04 VMs (RKE2), k3s and kubeadm smoke runs
- CI airgap-bundle-validate job (initial run timed out, second run succeeded)
- Manual upgrade from previously generated bundle to new bundle in a staging cluster (rollback exercised and validated)

Related: Linear ENG-4721 (onprem installer airgap improvements), INF-3118 (customer escalations for rke2 installs), SUP-5678 (support ticket for failing preflight).

Release notes: Vendors RKE2 and Ubuntu artifacts into the offline airgap bundle; improves installer detection and adds safer upgrade/rollback for RKE2-based clusters.
